headline: COP31 Talks Continue After Draft Drops Fossil-Fuel Language
deck: Countries remained deadlocked as negotiations ran overnight, without a new global climate deal.
body: COP31 negotiations in Turkey were deadlocked after running through the night without a new global climate deal, the BBC reported. [E1] The climate summit went into overtime as nearly 200 countries remained deadlocked over a draft that no longer mentions fossil fuels, Al Jazeera reported. [E3]
France and Panama led a group of countries pushing back against a draft that included no reference to reducing global demand for fossil fuels, the BBC reported. [E2]
